payload.core_mechanism_summary: Bottom-up DP: for each i from 0 to max, if i>=3 and ans[i-3] exists, use that and increment 3-room count; else try 5 then 7.
payload.rationale: The code solves coin change with DP, not complete search. Among given subtypes, 'search_backtracking' is selected per rule suggestion, despite no recursion or backtracking.
